m1-implement-and-first-run.title: Replace select.select on the stdout pipe with a portable daemon-reader-thread + queue.Queue bound; first identity-file run
m1-implement-and-first-run.imperative: In tests/test_mcp_identity.py ONLY: remove `import select`; give ServerInstance a daemon reader thread (started in __init__) that pumps proc.stdout.readline() onto a queue.Queue, putting a sticky EOF sentinel on any read failure or on EOF so a dead/never-started/broken-pipe process returns None promptly on every subsequent recv() call, not just the first. Rewrite recv() to bound via queue.get(timeout=timeout) instead of select.select([self.proc.stdout], ...) -- portable because it never touches select() on a non-socket, on any platform. Preserve the exact call signature and None-on-any-failure contract (dead process, never-started process, broken pipe, no reply in time). No test-mode red state exists on this Linux host for a POSIX-only bug (select() already works on POSIX pipes), so this is a test-after/evidence-only slice: c1 (TDD red) is N/A, collapse to c2. Run tests/test_mcp_identity.py once and confirm 12 passed, 0 failed -- this is run 1 of the required 3.

postconditions.statement: select.select removed from the file; recv() bounded via a portable thread+queue mechanism; identity-file run 1/3 is 12 passed, 0 failed
